item.title: About
item.description:
Hi, I’m Alif Naufal, based in Indonesia — you might know me online as n6ufal.

I studied English Literature. These days I’m learning whatever catches my attention, building small things when the idea sticks, and overthinking more than I probably should.

Most of what I write here sits somewhere between random thoughts and things I’m trying to figure out in real time. I tend to lose ideas I thought were interesting, so this is my way of keeping track of what I’m thinking and feeling.

item.title: Hello World!
item.description:
I made this site as a personal outlet. Somewhere to learn, mess around, and dump whatever’s been sitting in my head.

It started when I got the GitHub Student Pack and figured — why dump stuff on Medium when I could just have my own thing? So I built it. Hugo, GitHub Pages, custom domain. Figured it out as I went. When it finally worked — that feeling of I made this was kind of hard to beat. I love it and here’s HEADSPACE.

item.title: Now
item.description:
Thinking about

There’s a serious situation happening at my campus involving verbal and sexual abuse. It’s been weighing on me and my friends.

Some of them are actively helping mediate and facilitate between the victims and the campus authorities in case things escalate. This isn’t something small.

I’ll write more about my point of view soon.

Listening to

Deep prog house, dream pop, shoegaze, midwest emo, post-hardcore.

Note

This page changes whenever I feel like it.
